text_block_list.text:
I beat you, you beat me not! I beat you,
you beat
me not!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
I BEAT YOU! Hah! How do ya like that? I
won!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: I can't believe I lost to a weirdo like you! Ughhh, this sucks.
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text:
Oh? You mad, bro? Wanna go again?
'Cause I'm
down.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: You are literally the worst! This is not over!
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text:
Next time, I'm gonna take you on in one
of those
big races, and you're gonna be
toast.
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text:
Oho! One of the big 'uns, huh? Sure,
you're on!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
It doesn't seem like it'll be long before
Голд Шип
and Тосэн Джордан face off
again.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: And before I forget, here.
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text: Huh? What's this?
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Like I know. Someone just told me to
give it to
you. Later.
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text: Well then, let's have a look-see.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: Yeah. This one says "QUA."
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
The paper Flash gave me had "UM," and
now I've
got "QUA." It's all clear now...
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Clear that I've got no clue what this
means, that
is!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
The meaning of the hints might not be
clear, but
there is something that is.
Since both Эйсин Флэш
and Tosen
Jordan had a clue...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It must mean someone is orchestrating
this and
giving them the information.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Who's the mastermind behind this
"Eden" Gold
Ship is pursuing, and what
is their agenda? I can't
help but be
intrigued.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Голд Шип! Congrats on defending the
title!
text_block_list.name: Наблюдатель A

text_block_list.text:
I was on the edge of my seat, worried
you might
stumble! But you did it again!
text_block_list.name: Spectator B

text_block_list.text: Hey, thanks!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: Hold on... Again? What did I do again?
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип
choice_data_list:
You won the Takarazuka Kinen last year too,
remember?

text_block_list.text:
Huh? Seriously? Wow, I'm actually really

awesome.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: C'mon now. If you're gonna celebrate me, celebrate me like you mean it.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: Bwahaha! Etched into history, huh?!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
What a monumental achievement!
Hahaha!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
It's official! I flourish when showered with

compliments!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
But you know, when you say it that way,
it really
sets my soul on fire!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
I'll come back burning even hotter next
year!
From the second the race
starts—no, even better,
the second I
walk through the gate, I'll unleash my

blazing intensity!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Голд Шипп is already in senior year.
There is no
"next year" in her debut
series. And besid—
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: BURN BABY, BUUURN!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
I have a feeling she might do something
rash...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Make sure you really heap 'em on in the
future
too, okay?
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna pick up some red and white
bean buns.
You can have the doughy
part.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип
